name: allowance-guard-extension
description: AllowanceGuard Browser Extension - Protect your wallet from risky token approvals

scripts.build:chrome: mkdir -p dist && cp src/background.js src/content.js src/popup.js dist/ && cp popup.html dist/ && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp -r icons dist/
scripts.build:firefox: mkdir -p dist-firefox && cp src/background.firefox.js dist-firefox/background.js && cp src/content.js dist-firefox/ && cp src/popup.js dist-firefox/ && cp popup.html dist-firefox/ && cp manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist-firefox/
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run watch
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd dist && zip -r ../allowance-guard-chrome.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist-firefox && zip -r ../allowance-guard-firefox.zip .

author: Allowance Guard Team
